calibration.measurement_plane: Scope input after the existing direct coax cables; cable loss included
calibration.method: Median of AC RMS = sqrt(VRMS^2 - VAVG^2); 16-acquisition scope averaging
calibration.limitations: Scope-referenced AC power of a sine wave into physical 50-ohm loads. Includes measured cable loss; not a traceable absolute RF power calibration or a measurement of fundamental power alone.
